name: @between-gigs/design-system
description: Between Gigs design system: tokens, Tailwind v4 theme, React components.

scripts.docs:bundle: node scripts/build-bundle.mjs dist/docs-bundle.js && tailwindcss -i styles/docs-bundle.css -o dist/docs-bundle.css --minify
scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:values && npm run icons:check && npm run docs:bundle && npm run docs:previews && node scripts/build-showcase.mjs
scripts.qa: python3 scripts/qa/harness.py && node scripts/qa/axe.mjs && node scripts/qa/keyboard.mjs && node scripts/qa/inspect.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run qa
